summary: Rerun pilot-only screen comparison: GBM 100iter/bins64, 6-config grid, stab05/stab03/top20F, 1 seed; lock best
reasoning: Supersedes step-7: the run timed out because a max_iter=300 HistGB fit costs 7.7 s here even single-threaded (bisection: uv ok 2.5 s, loadtxt 0 s, fits 3-8 s, 13 ms/iter floor). Revised budget: max_iter=100, max_bins=64 gives ~1 s/fit, so 3 variants x 5 outer x (6 configs x 4 inner + 1) fits finish in ~7 min. Expectation unchanged and still grounded in the sealed/established precedents (stab screen 20 feats cv 0.73 vote step-22; stability screen 10 feats + tuned GBM cv 0.7645 fleet2-boost step-25; stab05 locks 11 features on this pilot, stab03 18), so the chosen variant's nested cv_auc should be >= 0.70 with n_features <= 50, written to out/metrics.json.
